name: 二つの累積面の比較
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONLY Lighthouse catalog component LH17-0004 二つの累積面の比較, a two-series cumulative area comparison from the same origin. Landscape390x280logical, crisp enlarged raster, pure-white exterior and white rounded card with fine neutral outline and very soft downward shadow. Compact chart, no new title, legend, metric, tab or control.
Reference hierarchy: Image1 ORIGINAL Linear screenshot is primary for series distinction, thin line optical weight, shared-origin geometry, alignment and subtle area gradients. The relevant region is the small upper-right progress plot only. Image2 saved native mock is SECONDARY for isolated plot framing and Japanese dates; correct its flat, heavy fills and indistinguishable green-series treatment. Image3 approved bus direction is style only for white rounded surfaces and restrained forest-green depth, no bus/map content.
Plot has exactly two straight cumulative boundary lines starting at the SAME lower-left point. Upper boundary ascends steeply to upper-right. Lower boundary ascends to right at about two thirds of upper rise. Both share the same horizontal baseline; right edge closes each area. Preserve these two triangles, no curved lines, no extra datapoints, no y-axis, no grid and no invented values. At390pxlogicalwidth the plot runs roughlyx20..368, baseliney240, upper endpointy24, lower endpointy96. Fine neutral baseline. Under baseline, left label3月30日and right label4月6日, exactly. Meiryo Regular12/16, zero tracking, secondary#6E6E6E, never bold.
Accent decision from original: pink upper series and teal lower series denote DISTINCT data series. Restore that useful two-hue distinction instead of automatically making everything green. Lower series adapts to forest-green#1F6444, upper series retains a restrained rose accent#C6698B. Thin crisp strokes in those colors. Areas fade vertically down to transparent white, following original subtle gradient. Lower area in front, upper rose visible above it; no dark stacked solid block. Keep white page/canvas/card, no broad ambient tint, no mint background, no rainbow, no glow or gloss. No action exists in this isolated component, so do not invent a primary button merely to show brand. Original app chrome, English wording, watermark and surrounding health rows are out of scope. Apple Design clarity, purposeful hierarchy, aligned baselines and quiet materials. Static candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画Linearの同一起点・二直線・桃色と青緑の系列区別・下向きの淡い面グラデーションを目視。モックの緑2色の塗り潰しを改善し、下系列は森林緑、上系列は意味のあるローズの区別を維持。生成を目視し二つの直線、下系列の約2/3の高さ、3月30日と4月6日、白面・細線・欠落クリップなしを確認。凡例や数値は原画にないため追加なし。フォント実体・所有者承認・編集可能性・実装は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
